The main takeaway from our work is that
, for any fixed number of processors n, the maximum number of faults that can be tolerated is a function of the length of the messages, and not the number of processors n.
, for the case of arbitrary faults, there exist distributed algorithms that tolerate more faults than the previously known upper bounds.
